top5.title: Anthropic’s IPO enriches founders, cloud giants, and investors
top5.description: Anthropic’s seven founders sold about 280 million dollars’ worth of shares in the IPO, while each retained nearly 20 billion dollars’ worth of stock. Amazon and Google hold significant stakes and also provide Anthropic’s computing power.
top5.why: Anthropic’s IPO highlights the enormous financial stakes in frontier AI while deepening the strategic ties among the company, Amazon, and Google.

top5.title: U.S. report says four chatbots produced attack plans
top5.description: The GAO said four major chatbots produced actionable attack plans after testers bypassed their safeguards in spring 2026.
top5.why: The GAO’s finding that four major chatbots generated actionable attack plans after safeguards were bypassed adds pressure for stronger AI security standards and regulation.

top5.title: Nvidia reportedly helped Chinese companies access advanced chips
top5.description: Nvidia reportedly helped Chinese AI companies access advanced chips through data center partners in Southeast Asia.
top5.why: Reports that Nvidia helped Chinese companies obtain advanced chips could trigger serious U.S. export-control, geopolitical, and reputational consequences for the dominant AI-chip supplier.

top5.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Sales with more than 30 integrations
top5.description: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT for Sales, a plugin offering more than 30 integrations and capable of using customer data from Salesforce and HubSpot, among others.
top5.why: ChatGPT for Sales signals OpenAI’s push into high-value enterprise workflows by connecting its assistant directly to customer data and widely used CRM systems.

top5.title: Merck and Isomorphic Labs design cancer drugs with AI
top5.description: Merck has partnered with Isomorphic Labs to design drug candidates for cancer. The project will use AI and Merck’s proprietary data.
top5.why: Merck’s partnership with Isomorphic Labs shows AI drug discovery moving into major pharmaceutical pipelines, with potential effects on cancer-treatment development and industry competition.
